comment: The <<} of a comment that opened on an earlier line. Markdown's paragraph rule starts again at each line, which ends the comment's span from manuscript-markdown.json there, so its <<} is in no comment's span. Here it's scoped as the comment's closer, so it shows as one, and its } is a comment's, which no bracket pairs with. Inside a comment's span this injects nothing, so the comment's own end pattern pairs its <<}, and a reply's, as {>>note {>>reply<<}<<}, on one line.
